description: Monthly and yearly in-hand salary from an annual CTC in India under the new tax regime (FY 2026-27). Assumes employee and employer PF at 12% of basic capped at Rs 1,800 a month, gratuity at 4.81% of basic, and professional tax of Rs 200 a month. Variable pay is shown separately after its own tax.

basic_percent.description: Basic salary as % of fixed pay (default 50)

variable_pay_percent.description: Variable pay or bonus as % of CTC (default 0)

name: calculate_salary_in_hand
title: Salary in-hand from CTC
